For the signed projective ray operator R, the exact entrywise identity K²=q^(2m-1)(q-1)R+s q^(m-1)(q-1)^2K follows from dependent, orthogonal, and hyperbolic independent null-pair counts; signed-scaling subspace W has dimension P=(q^(2m)-1)/(q-1).
